```yaml
name: Build Linux Systemlibs

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential \
            libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libavutil-dev libswscale-dev libavfilter-dev libavdevice-dev libavresample-dev \
            libtesseract-dev libopenjp2-7-dev libjpeg-dev libpng-dev libz-dev libbz2-dev liblzma-dev libzstd-dev libwebp-dev \
            libx264-dev libx265-dev libvpx-dev libfreetype6-dev libfontconfig1-dev libssl-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libxml2-dev libxslt1-dev

      - name: Build basic variant
        run: |
          ./configure --system-libs
          make -j$(nproc)
          mkdir -p artifacts/basic
          cp ccextractor artifacts/basic/
          echo "Basic build ldd output:"
          ldd artifacts/basic/ccextractor
          make clean

      - name: Build hardsubx variant
        run: |
          ./configure --system-libs --hardsubx
          make -j$(nproc)
          mkdir -p artifacts/hardsubx
          cp ccextractor artifacts/hardsubx/
          echo "Hardsubx build ldd output:"
          ldd artifacts/hardsubx/ccextractor
          make clean

      - name: Upload basic artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-basic
          path: artifacts/basic/ccextractor

      - name: Upload hardsubx artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ccextractor-hardsubx
          path: artifacts/hardsubx/ccextractor
```
